title: Smale's 4th Problem: Integer Zeros of Polynomials
exact_target: The catalogue asks for efficient integer-root decisions. Its title points to a different Smale question about how many integer roots a univariate polynomial can have.

sources.citation: Ulam AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 48 (SMA-004). Catalogue curation and metadata: CC BY 4.0. The source extract is retained; definitions, English summaries and qualifications are editorial additions.

Steve Smale, Mathematical Problems for the Next Century, second version (7 August 1998), Problems 4 and 5, pp. 5--6. Consulted for the attribution and scope comparison; the catalogue decision wording differs.
Steve Smale, Mathematical Problems for the Next Century, Mathematical Intelligencer 20(2), 7--15 (1998).
